subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error mark 'No error' as your answer.

Father took the newspaper / in his hand to / go through it once again.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the preposition** "in" before "his hand."**
 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is **"with."**
 
• The correct phrase should be **"with his hand," **ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Father took the newspaper** with **his hand to go through it once again."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
 
• **Option 2: "Father took the newspaper"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "go through it once again"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "in his hand to"** – This part of the sentence contains the error. The correct phrase should be "with his hand to."
